;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[June 2019 Gulf of Oman incident]]
**An unnamed [[United States]] official claims that, just prior to the attack on two merchant vessels, an Iranian vessel launched a surface to air missile at a MQ-9 Reaper drone in the vicinity of the attack. An additional MQ-9 Reaper is reported to have been shot down by Houthi rebels several days prior in the [[Red Sea]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/06/14/politics/us-drone-tracked-iranian-boats/index.html (CNN)]
**The president of the Japanese shipping company  offers a different account of the attack than that provided by the United States. Yutaka Katada says the [[Filipinos|Filipino]] crew of the ''Kokuka Courageous'' oil tanker said their vessel was apparently first hit by an [[Shell (projectile)|artillery shell]] rather than a mine. The United States said the tanker was attacked by [[limpet mine]]s and released a video it says shows Iranian special forces removing an unexploded mine from the oil tanker's side. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/japanese-ship-owner-contradicts-us-account-of-how-tanker-was-attacked/2019/06/14/7ea347d0-8eba-11e9-b6f4-033356502dce_story.html?utm_term=.df5f200cba2a (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-48633016 (BBC News)]
**A [[United States|U.S.]] official says [[Islamic Republic of Iran Navy|Iranian Navy]] [[Seraj|gunboats]] are preventing the damaged Norwegian-owned ''Front Altair'' oil tanker from being towed away by two private tugboats in the [[Gulf of Oman]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-attacks-usa-tugboats/iran-fast-boats-preventing-towing-of-damaged-altair-tanker-source-idUSKCN1TF2AP (Reuters)]
**[[United Nations]] Secretary-General [[António Guterres]] calls for an independent investigation to establish the facts and responsibility for the oil tankers attacks in the Gulf of Oman. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-attacks-un/u-n-chief-calls-for-independent-probe-into-gulf-tanker-attacks-idUSKCN1TF24W?il=0 (Reuters)]
;Disasters and accidents
*At least 61 people have been killed and 356,000 evacuated from their homes as heavy rain and floods swept through large parts of southern and central [[China]] this week. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/china-flood-death-toll-jumps-61-ministry-190614005730068.html (Al Jazeera)]

;International relations
*[[Iran–Japan relations]], [[Iran–United States relations]]
**[[Kyodo News Agency]] reports that during his visit to mediate between the U.S. and Iran, Japanese PM [[Shinzō Abe]] asked Iran to release American prisoners held by Iran, though the response is "unclear" to the press. But Iran says it will not negotiate with the United States, rejecting Abe's bid to broker dialogue between the two countries amid escalating tensions in the Middle East. Iranian Foreign Minister [[Javad Zarif]] accuses the "B-Team" ([[Mohammed bin Salman]], [[John R. Bolton|John Bolton]] and [[Benjamin Netanyahu]]) of sabotaging diplomacy, including Abe's meeting, to hide its "economic terrorism" by accusing Iran of [[June 2019 Gulf of Oman incident|attacking oil tankers]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/japans-abe-asked-iran-to-release-us-hostages-report-says-but-the-response-is-unclear/2019/06/13/43e501e0-8e4e-11e9-b162-8f6f41ec3c04_story.html?noredirect=on&utm_term=.2abd005bad62 (''The Washington Post'')] [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2019/06/ad9943adea62-japan-scrambles-for-information-on-ship-attacks-near-strait-of-hormuz.html (Kyodo News)]
*[[Cyprus dispute|Cyprus—Turkey relations]]
**[[Southern Europe|European Union Mediterranean state]] leaders offer full support to fellow EU member [[Cyprus]] in its dispute with [[Turkey]] over offshore natural gas deposit ownership. [[President of the French Republic|French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]], speaking for the EU, urges Turkey to stop “illegal activities” in Cyprus’s [[exclusive economic zone]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-summit-mediterranean/southern-eu-leaders-back-cyprus-in-gas-dispute-with-turkey-idUSKCN1TF2JG?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-france-macron/frances-macron-sides-with-cyprus-on-dispute-with-turkey-idUSKCN1TF2FO?il=0 (Reuters²)]
;Law and crime
*[[Transgender personnel in the United States military]]
**The [[United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit|Ninth U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals]], without ruling on the merits, orders U.S. District Judge [[Marsha J. Pechman|Marsha Pechman]] ([[Seattle]]) to reconsider her ruling against the ban of most transgender people from the military, stating she did not give the military’s judgment enough deference. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-transgender/trump-wins-u-s-court-victory-in-quest-for-transgender-military-ban-idUSKCN1TF1ZM (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Presidency of Jair Bolsonaro]]
**In response to a controversial pension reform proposal and cuts in the education budget, a general strike by over 40 million workers takes place in [[Brazil]]. Demonstrations are held in over 80 cities across the country. [https://www.france24.com/en/20190614-brazil-strike-disrupts-transport-ahead-copa-america (France24)]
